blocks.rationale: Install a joint three-skill package targeting all three trigger failures: the two statutory exception/amount comparisons and exact airline baggage aggregation. Each helper is narrowly scoped, reads all related current-source facts and rule parameters jointly, returns the native answer type, and should not displace the unrelated history tasks.

inputs.name: source_excludes_noncash_agricultural_remuneration

inputs.name: proposition_asserts_inclusion
inputs.question: Does the current proposition assert that the payment is included within the claimed wages provision?

skill.intent: Classify whether remuneration for agricultural labor paid in a noncash medium is included as wages when the current source contains a noncash-agricultural-remuneration exclusion.

outputs.description: The native binary label Entailment or Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

origin.quote: Over the year 2018, Alice has paid $2325 in hay to Bob for agricultural labor.

source_obligations.statement: Check whether the current remuneration is for agricultural labor and was paid in a noncash medium.

origin.quote: (11) remuneration for agricultural labor paid in any medium other than cash;

source_obligations.statement: Treat noncash remuneration for agricultural labor as excluded from wages and compare that result with the proposition's asserted inclusion.

source_provenance.quote: For purposes of this chapter, the term "wages" means all remuneration for employment, including the cash value of all remuneration (including benefits) paid in any medium other than cash; except that such term shall not include-
(11) remuneration for agricultural labor paid in any medium other than cash;

origin.quote: Alice is entitled to an exemption under section 151(d) for Bob for the year 2015.

source_obligations.statement: Determine whether the current facts make the individual's deduction allowable to another taxpayer for the relevant year.

origin.quote: In the case of an individual with respect to whom a deduction under this section is allowable to another taxpayer for a taxable year beginning in the calendar year in which the individual's taxable year begins, the exemption amount applicable to such individual for such individual's taxable year shall be zero.

source_obligations.statement: When the deduction is allowable to another taxpayer, use the source-prescribed zero amount instead of the general exemption amount.

origin.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this subsection, the term "exemption amount" means $2,000.

source_obligations.statement: Return Entailment only when the asserted amount equals the exemption amount produced by the applicable current-source rules.

source_provenance.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this subsection, the term "exemption amount" means $2,000.

In the case of an individual with respect to whom a deduction under this section is allowable to another taxpayer for a taxable year beginning in the calendar year in which the individual's taxable year begins, the exemption amount applicable to such individual for such individual's taxable year shall be zero.
In the case of a taxable year beginning after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026, the term "exemption amount" means zero.

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Apply the current count and per-axis dimension limits before treating remaining items as checked bags.

origin.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

source_obligations.statement: Calculate each checked bag's size by adding its outside length, width, and height.

origin.quote: More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: When both an oversize and overweight surcharge apply, add the higher surcharge, along with the ordinal checked-bag fee, to the ticket total.

source_provenance.quote: Your personal item like a purse or small handbag must fit under the seat in front of you. Dimensions should not exceed 18 x 14 x 8 inches (45 x 35 x 20 cm).
The total size of your carry-on, including the handles and wheels, cannot exceed 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) and must fit in the sizer at the airport.

For all regions, except to / from Australia or New Zealand, your checked bag allowance is:
* Dimension: 62 in / 158 cm
* Weight: 50 lbs / 23 kgs
* For First / Business, weight is 70 lbs / 32 kgs for complimentary bags and 50 lbs / 23 kgs for excess charged bags
More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.
